authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism with coherent lighting, depth of field, and detailed fur textures. However, several AI artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Koala paws lack defined digit/claw anatomy, appearing smooth or fused with toys/branch (severity 2); (2) Red car wheels show slight elliptical distortion and vague mechanical connections (severity 2); (3) Alphabet block text has minor edge bleeding (severity 1). The animal pose auditor's HIGH artifact risk (47% low-confidence keypoints in limb regions) corroborates the paw/limb anatomical simplification. These are localized defects that don't compromise overall coherence but prevent perfect authenticity.
